findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "feature_app" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user wants their app in the appdesigns gallery (appdesigns.click/apps): a screenshot set they saved (asset_id, from save_to_account or list_pr…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, create_design, feature_app · Private data: create_project, replace_screenshots, export_asset, get_export · Public sink: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, create_design, update_design, get_asset, edit_asset, replace_screenshots, export_asset, feature_app · Destructive: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, update_design, list_projects, get_asset, edit_asset, save_to_account, replace_screenshots, translate_asset, export_asset, get_export, feature_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, create_design, feature_app · Private data: create_project, replace_screenshots, export_asset, get_export · Public sink: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, create_design, update_design, get_asset, edit_asset, replace_screenshots, export_asset, feature_app · Destructive: get_workflow, create_project, get_design_guide, update_design, list_projects, get_asset, edit_asset, save_to_account, replace_screenshots, translate_asset, export_asset, get_export, feature_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
